dtoConventions.f64: exact16 lowercase IEEE754 bit string; no host numeric conversion
dtoConventions.payload: Complete old camelCase DTO plus full publication/null; all marker and metadata fields retained
dtoConventions.publication: full original fixed v4 object; upper flags JSON booleans/returnOrigin null; no synthetic table
dtoConventions.rawCore: Existing Node output interface without optional call_roots/view_lifetimes; expected actual Node emission only for new8 Source cases. Old2 cold raw Core is independent generic data, never Source output.
